title: Vijnana Aranya, Chiguru Srujana Shaale, Hosabidarahalli
location: Chiguru Srujana Shaale, Hosabidarahalli, H.D. Kote
teaser: Vijnana Aranya at Chiguru Srujana Shaale with sessions on origami, clay modelling, and art-integrated learning for 6th, 7th, and 8th standard students.
homepageMatter: On 13 August 2025, tAcT conducted a Vijnana Aranya at Chiguru Srujana Shaale, Hosabidarahalli, H.D. Kote taluk. Sessions included biological concepts through origami (8th standard), environmental awareness through clay modelling, and art and science of mask-making.
